name: Series 4 Rechargeable Responder (Blue)
official_name: Series 4 Rechargeable Responder (RadaScan family)
brand_shown: Guidance Marine (Wartsila Guidance Marine on older documents)
description: Responders are coded microwave targets that RadaScan sensors track. The rechargeable version needs no battery-pack maintenance and suits keeping on the vessel for handover to platforms, while PCP and mains versions suit permanent installation. They are ATEX and CSA certified with a unique coded ID.
features: Unique coded ID with auto target detection
ATEX and CSA certified
360 degree navigation off one responder
Universal swivel bracket for all power and mounting options
No maintenance on the rechargeable unit

specs.v: mains, primary cell pack, self-contained battery

brand_note: Maker confirmed. Series 4 rechargeable responder is mentioned in a Guidance Marine/FCC manual listing; the colour 'Blue' and part 20-0276-BLU not verified. Guidance's page describes rechargeable responders generally, not a Series 4 product page.
notes: No product photo of the responder from an OEM page; Series 4 detail from search snippets only.

name: CyScan 8-Way Prism Cluster
official_name: SpotTrack eight-prism cluster (Kongsberg)
brand_shown: Kongsberg (SpotTrack eight-prism cluster); generic prism clusters also sold by others
description: A prism cluster mounts several glass retro-reflector prisms together so a laser DP sensor can see the target over a wider angle and at longer range. Kongsberg offers an eight-prism cluster in sealed canisters among its SpotTrack reflective targets, alongside single-prism options.
features: Eight prisms in one cluster for wider angle of visibility
Sealed canisters, industry-standard prisms
Single prism and magnetic-mount variants also offered
Glass prisms extend range beyond the 500 m zone (per Guidance)
brand_note: Kongsberg lists an eight-prism cluster among SpotTrack Prisms. Guidance Marine sells its own prisms (AS Prism) and says glass prisms work with DP sensors of any manufacturer. Maker of Sinor's 8-way cluster is therefore not settled: Kongsberg SpotTrack, Guidance, or other. Compatibility with CyScan comes from a distributor snippet only.
notes: Kongsberg image is small (333 px); no specs read (datasheet PDF not opened).

name: RADius 700x Transponder
official_name: RADius 700X transponder
description: The RADius 700X is an intrinsically safe, battery-powered transponder for the RADius relative positioning system, intended for large installations such as platforms and FPSOs where ATEX certification is required. Each unit carries a unique ID set by dip switches, and several interrogators can use the same transponder.
features: Intrinsically safe encapsulated battery, no wired connection
Unique ID set by dip switches
Multi-user: several interrogators per transponder
Suitable for hazardous zones 1 and 2
brand_note: Confirmed for 700X on kongsberg.com. 550X listed separately by Kongsberg. Replacement battery: a 'RADius EX Battery' is listed by Kongsberg.

name: Sonardyne HPT 5000 USBL Transceiver
official_name: HPT 5000 USBL transceiver (Type 8142-001)
description: The HPT 5000 is a High Performance Transceiver for Ranger 2 and Marksman systems with full hemispherical acoustic coverage, making it a popular choice for tracking several targets over varied depths. Built in aluminium bronze, it can be fitted over the side, through a tube or through the hull.
features: Full hemispherical acoustic coverage
6G platform with multi-element processing
Telemetry up to 9,000 bps
Over-the-side, through-tube or through-hull fitting
Gyro USBL configuration available

specs.v: 48 V dc, typical 15 W, max 120 W

brand_note: HPT 5000 is Type 8142-001 (MF, 20-34 kHz). Part number 620-7181 from the hint is not on the page (UNVERIFIED). Type 8142-002 is the deepwater optimised unit, i.e. the HPT 7000 variant, so confirm Sinor's unit is -001.
notes: Page scraped in full. Check images visually.

name: Sonardyne Wideband Sub-Mini 6+ (WSM 6+) Transponder
official_name: Wideband Sub-Mini 6+ (WSM 6+) Transponder/Responder
description: WSM 6+ is a small, rugged, rechargeable USBL transponder for tracking ROVs, towfish, crane wires and other mobile underwater targets. It uses two-way Wideband 2 signals, with legacy Wideband 1 and HPR 400 support, and works with all Ranger 2 USBL systems. It runs in transponder or responder mode and has a depth sensor and external on/off switch as standard.

Responder mode for faster position updates
Depth sensor fitted as standard
Configurable by serial link or acoustically via iWand

name: Kongsberg cNode Transponder
official_name: cNODE Micro Transponder (and cNODE MiniS Transponder)
description: The cNODE Micro is the smallest cNODE transponder, rated to 600 m and light enough for divers and shallow water ROVs. It uses Kongsberg Cymbal digital acoustic protocols with SSBL and LBL positioning, and works with Kongsberg positioning systems from uPAP to HiPAP. The larger cNODE MiniS comes in 4,000 m and 7,000 m housings with 500+ Cymbal channels and a responder mode.
features: Micro: SSBL and LBL, range accuracy better than 2 cm
Micro: 180 degree omnidirectional beam, internal tilt sensor
Micro: rechargeable Li-Ion battery, external on/off
MiniS: 4,000 m or 7,000 m depth rating, responder mode
MiniS: compatible with HiPAP, uPAP and cPAP
brand_note: cNODE Micro and cNODE MiniS (spelled 'MiniS' by Kongsberg) confirmed on kongsberg.com. Type numbers 31-180 and 34-180 were not on the product pages; '34-180' appears in the title of a Kongsberg cNODE Maxi manual (34-180-Si3), so the mapping of 34-180 to Minis is UNVERIFIED and may be wrong. Kongsberg pages now carry the Kongsberg Discovery name.
notes: Image sizes are small tiles. The MiniS page did not list a frequency band or dimensions.

name: MRU-B1 Heave Sensor
description: MRU-B1 is the heave model of the Inertial Labs Basic (B) motion reference units. It uses solid-state MEMS gyroscopes, accelerometers and a barometric sensor in a small IP67 housing, and outputs in Inertial Labs binary, NMEA 0183, TSS1 and Kongsberg Seatex formats.

specs.v: Heave, with velocity and acceleration (datasheet); the website table also lists surge and sway

name: MRU-B1.1 Pitch and Roll Sensor
description: MRU-B1.1 is the pitch and roll model of the Inertial Labs Basic (B) motion reference units. It shares the compact IP67 MEMS housing of the MRU-B1 and carries an ABS design assessment.

search_hints: Inertial Labs MRU B2 motion reference unit
official_name: Inertial Labs MRU-B2 Motion Reference Unit (family: MRU-B1, B1.1, B2)
description: Inertial Labs' MRU-B2 is a compact strap-down MEMS motion sensor that outputs heave, surge, sway, pitch and roll. It can emit Kongsberg Seatex and Teledyne TSS data formats so it can replace older MRUs, and the range carries an ABS design assessment certificate. Subsea (1000 m) versions are listed for the B-series.
features: MRU-B2: heave, surge, sway, pitch and roll
MRU-B1: heave, surge, sway; MRU-B1.1: pitch and roll (per Inertial Labs table)
Seatex and TSS-1 compatible output formats
ABS design assessment certificate 19-HS1851412-PDA
IP67 or subsea enclosed options
brand_note: CONFIRMED: Inertial Labs (inertiallabs.com) makes MRU-B1, MRU-B1.1, MRU-B2 (plus E, P, PD and subsea versions); MRU-B2 is also sold as a rental unit by Norwegian Offshore Rental and by Ocean Science Technology. Caution: Inertial Labs' table lists B1 as heave/surge/sway only and B1.1 as pitch and roll, whereas the register says 'B1 (roll and pitch)'. name: Anschutz Standard 22 Gyro Compass
official_name: Anschutz Standard 22 gyro compass (current model: Standard 22 NX)

It uses patented slip-ring-free data transmission and is IMO approved as a gyro compass and rate-of-turn gyro. Offshore supply vessels, tankers and cruise ships are named as typical users.

Automatic speed and latitude error correction
Bridge alert management compliant
Quick settling mode to 1 hour (option)
12 RS-422 outputs via distribution unit

official_name: YOUNG 86106 Ultrasonic Anemometer (Marine)

Preconfigured NMEA output; RS-232, RS-485 and several formats available
Analog voltage and 4-20 mA outputs

IP65 protection

Communication software included
Connects to the Observator display line

Iridium filtering

Rugged design for marine use
5/8 inch-11 thread or 3 x M8 surface mount
